members.name: intents_a
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent does it express? Pick the single option that best matches what the customer wants or the problem they report.

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a card, or trouble activating / reactivating a card the customer has received.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open or use an account; whether children or teenagers can have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using or setting up Apple Pay, Google Pay or a smartwatch wallet, including topping up through them or them not working.
criteria.atm_support: Where to find an ATM, or which ATMs accept the card (general ATM availability, not a problem with a specific withdrawal).
criteria.automatic_top_up: The automatic top-up feature: whether it exists, how to set it up, how it works, its limits.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: The customer made or received a specific bank transfer and their own account balance does not show it yet. This includes messages that ask how long a transfer normally takes while saying a transfer they just made (e.g. from their account at another bank) is not showing up.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A cheque or cash deposit (any money the customer says they deposited) was made but the balance has not updated or the money is not showing yet.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: The customer cannot add or pay a particular beneficiary / payee, or a beneficiary was rejected.
criteria.cancel_transfer: The customer wants to cancel, stop or reverse a transfer or money transaction they already made (e.g. sent to the wrong account). Not for cancelling a purchase of goods or services, which is a refund request.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: The card is expiring or has expired: getting a replacement, what happens, cost or timing of the renewal card.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where or by which merchants the card is accepted; whether shops/businesses accept it.
criteria.card_arrival: A card that was ordered has not arrived yet; tracking a card that was sent; is the card lost in the mail.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, when a card will arrive, whether it can be delivered faster or by a certain date, delivery time to a country.
criteria.card_linking: Linking or adding an existing card to the app/account, or re-adding a card (e.g. a card that was found) to the app.
criteria.card_not_working: The card is generally not working or broken, without a specific declined payment, ATM decline or contactless issue.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a card payment/purchase; why paying with the card costs extra; also general complaints or questions about which fees the bank charges on payments and when (but fees for banking abroad in general are transfer fees).
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment/purchase on the statement that the customer does not recognise or did not make.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A card purchase in a foreign currency got the wrong or a bad exchange rate.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept, ate or retained the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: A fee charged for withdrawing cash at an ATM, or whether ATM withdrawals cost anything.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make or does not recognise, including cash or a cash amount shown in the app that the customer did not take out or receive.
criteria.change_pin: Changing or resetting the PIN, where/how a PIN can be changed.
criteria.compromised_card: Someone else may have access to or be using the card or card details (fraud suspicion, copied card), not a lost/stolen physical card.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank / account / cards are available or supported in.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment at a shop or online was declined or rejected.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined or not authorised.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined / refused / not allowed by the bank.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit on the account that the customer does not recognise or did not authorise.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits or restrictions of disposable virtual cards: how many uses, what they can be used for.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal or account details such as name, address, contact information.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees or extra charges for exchanging one currency into another.
criteria.exchange_rate: What the exchange rates are, where they come from, how they are set or why they vary (not a complaint about a specific wrong rate).
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange one currency for another in the app, or whether a particular exchange is possible.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: One specific unexplained extra charge or fee seen on the statement or in the app (often a small amount such as one pound, euro or dollar), without saying it came from a card payment, transfer, withdrawal or top-up.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer that failed, did not go through or was returned (an error, not a decline decision).
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies the account can hold or exchange.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get or create a disposable virtual card, who can get one.
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting a physical card, including finding or receiving the PIN that belongs with the card.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional, extra or second card; how many cards can be held; cards for family members.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get, order or find a virtual card; a virtual card not yet received.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card is lost, missing or stolen, or was lost and found again.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone is lost, stolen or left behind and the customer cannot use the app or worries about account access.
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a physical/new card: how to order, cost of a new card, where cards can be delivered.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgotten, reset or not working app passcode or login code.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment/purchase is still pending or has not gone through yet.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is shown as pending / in progress.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up the customer made is still pending, processing, or they are waiting for it to come through / be credited.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer the customer sent is shown as pending, still processing or not completed yet, and they ask why or how much longer.
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN is blocked, usually after too many wrong attempts; unblocking it.
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money from other people or an employer: friends sending money, salary paid into the account (questions naming SWIFT or SEPA belong to top-up by bank transfer fees).
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund that was expected or issued has not shown up in the account.
criteria.request_refund: The customer wants their money back for something they bought: a refund for a purchase, cancelling a purchase or order they no longer want, or how refunds work.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted, returned or cancelled and the money came back to the account.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards and currencies can be used to add money / top up, including whether a particular card brand or card type is accepted for adding money (questions only about Visa vs Mastercard belong to visa_or_mastercard).
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer; also any question that names SWIFT or SEPA transfers: whether the bank supports or accepts them, how to make one, or what they cost. Not for general how-to questions about bank transfers that name neither the cost nor SWIFT/SEPA.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up with a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up attempt failed, was declined, cancelled or did not go through at all.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-ups: maximum amount, how many, how often.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted or returned: the money appeared in the account and was then taken back or vanished.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: The process of topping up with a debit or credit card (how to do it), including sending or transferring money into the account using a credit card.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction was charged twice / duplicated.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a transfer, or on something the customer calls a transfer (e.g. they thought transfers were free); why transfers cost money; also fees or higher fees for using the account or doing banking from abroad / internationally, when no card purchase, ATM withdrawal or currency exchange is named.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How the customer can move their own money into this account by bank transfer from another account of theirs; general questions about which ways exist to add money to the account, and how topping up by ordinary bank transfer works or whether it is allowed.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The person or business the customer sent money to says they have not received it, or the customer reports the recipient has not got it.
criteria.transfer_timing: General questions about how long transfers take to arrive (in general or from/to a given country), when no specific transfer is reported as missing from the balance, pending, or not received.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: The customer cannot complete or failed identity verification; the app does not recognise them.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity and which documents are needed.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or showing where the customer's money comes from (source of funds).
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or the card used to top up, e.g. the verification code.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card does not work or a payment with it was rejected.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Any question that names Visa or Mastercard as card networks: whether the card is one or the other, choosing between them, or whether the bank offers or accepts them.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification or personal information is required.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: An ATM gave less (or a different amount of) cash than requested or charged.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal in a foreign currency got the wrong exchange rate.

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a card, or trouble activating / reactivating a card the customer has received.
